title: the first self value inside map, filter, reduce, nested blocks or one branch builds one object
purpose: Leaves and nodes made in iteration blocks and branches all point at the finished object; empty collections, fields bound before and after the escape, uses before and after a loop and cyclic equality behave as with an early let.

provenance.expected_basis: Owner decision on #279: early self is built once, at a point that dominates the rest of the constructor, keeping bound fields, later obj.init, the $pending lifecycle (#271), identity and cyclic equality (#278).
